The structure of Nd8In4Cu4 (reduced formula Nd2InCu) is cubic with space group F-43m (No. 216) and 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and In each adopt a tetrahedral environment with four Nd neighbors, while Nd is coordinated by two Cu and two In neighbors, all with neighbor distances of 3.1452 Å. The tetrahedral polyhedra connect through corner-sharing between Cu and In tetrahedra, and through both corner- and edge-sharing among like tetrahedra, forming a three-dimensional geometric network.
